verses.text: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim and told them, ‘I brought you out of Egypt and brought you into the land I swore to give your ancestors. I said, “I’ll never break my covenant with you.” 🗣️
‘I also said, “Don’t make treaties with the people living in this land. Tear down their altars.” But you didn’t listen to me. Why did you do that? ⚠️
‘So I also said, “I won’t drive them out ahead of you. They’ll be thorns at your sides, and their gods will trap you.”’ 🌵
When Yahweh’s angel said this to all Israel, the people raised their voices and wept. 😢
They named that place Bochim, the Weepers, and offered sacrifices to Yahweh there. 😭
After Joshua had sent the people off, each Israelite went to their own inheritance to take possession of the land. 🏡
The people served Yahweh all through Joshua’s life and through the lives of the elders who outlived him and had seen all the great work Yahweh did for Israel. 📜
Joshua son of Nun, Yahweh’s servant, died at 110 years old. 🕊️
They buried him inside his inheritance at Timnath-heres in Ephraim’s hill country, north of Mount Gaash. 🪦
After that whole generation had joined their ancestors in death, a new generation grew up. They didn’t know Yahweh or the work he had done for Israel. 🕰️
Israel’s people did evil in Yahweh’s sight and served the Baals. ⚠️
They abandoned Yahweh, their ancestors’ God, who brought them out of Egypt. They chased the gods of the peoples around them, bowed down to them, and made Yahweh angry. ⚠️
They abandoned Yahweh and served Baal and the Ashtaroth. ⚠️
Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel. He handed them over to raiders who plundered them and sold them to their surrounding enemies. They couldn’t stand against those enemies anymore. ⚔️
Everywhere Israel went, Yahweh’s hand was against them for harm, just as he had warned and sworn. They were in deep distress. 😔
Then Yahweh raised up judges who rescued them from the people raiding and plundering them. 🛡️

But they didn’t listen to their judges. They were unfaithful to Yahweh with other gods and bowed down to them. They quickly left the path their ancestors had followed, the path of obeying Yahweh’s commands. They didn’t do what was right. ⚠️

Whenever Yahweh raised up a judge, he was with that judge and rescued Israel from its enemies for the judge’s whole lifetime. Yahweh felt their pain as they groaned under the people oppressing and troubling them. 🛡️

But when the judge died, Israel went right back to corruption—worse than the generation before—chasing other gods, serving them, and bowing down. They wouldn’t quit their ways or drop their stubborn habits. 🔁
Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel. He said, ‘This nation broke my covenant, the one I commanded their ancestors to keep, and they haven’t listened to me. ⚠️
‘So I won’t drive out any of the nations Joshua left behind when he died. 🛑
‘I’ll use these nations to test Israel and see whether they’ll stay on Yahweh’s path and walk in it like their ancestors did—or not.’ 🧭
So Yahweh left those nations there. He didn’t rush to drive them out or hand them over to Joshua. 🕰️
